spec: A28 (2026-09-19, owner-approved) — the Focus Card design system (design/focus-card-system.md): Varsity light, Midnight dark, navy ink, orange a point and never a field; the type scale. Part III's table is superseded by A28 (a); Ember laws ①–⑥ stand with ④ narrowed by A28 (b). 6.4 motion & haptic language unchanged. Gap resolutions G4/G5/G8 logged in Appendix A 2026-09-04 (G4's dark values superseded by A28 (a)).

canvas.role: Every page background — Varsity cream / Midnight navy

card.role: Cards and the sheet surface — one step off the canvas (1.10:1 light, 1.21:1 dark); light lifts it with the card shadow, dark with tone alone

ink.role: NAVY ink — all text and structure, every icon and glyph, every text button, the stepper's plus and minus, the completed check, completed progress segments, heat-map done-days, day marks, the streak and ring numerals, the selected tab, and the primary capsule's fill (it inverts with the mode). 13.29 / 14.61 light and 15.05 / 12.46 dark on canvas / card
ink.spec: A28 (a), (b); design/focus-card-system.md §2 — supersedes Part III's charcoal #211D19 / #F5F1EB

inkSecondary.role: Secondary text, eyebrows, quiet fact rows, the off-season snowflake. 5.84 / 6.42 light and 7.03 / 5.82 dark on canvas / card

inkMuted.role: Muted marks — the unlit flame at zero; carries NO text below 24 pt (3.32 / 3.64 light, 3.98 / 3.29 dark on canvas / card: a graphical object, never small text)

hairlineOnCard.role: The seam between two rows inside a card — a boundary between surfaces, never a control's boundary

hairlineOnCanvas.role: A seam drawn on the canvas (the tab bar's top rule) — a boundary between surfaces, never a control's boundary

controlBorder.role: The stepper's 1.5 pt ring. ~1.6:1 by design (§6): a control drawn with it is identified by its ink glyph, which clears 3:1 — it is never a control's only mark (R-083)

segmentEmpty.role: Segmented workout bar — a pending set

segmentCurrent.role: Segmented workout bar — the current exercise's segments (also 8 pt tall against 6 pt, so height carries the state too)

chevron.role: A row button's chevron — decoration; the row's name identifies the control

ringTrack.role: The weekly ring's track — a neutral in both modes, never a tint of the accent (a wash over a 140 pt circle is a field)

heatEmpty.role: Heat map — a day with no workout (done-days are ink)

accent.role: ORANGE IS A POINT, NOT A FIELD — exactly three places: the flame glyph (fill), the weekly ring's progress arc (stroke), the celebration's XP numeral and its unit (text). Never a background, never on a control, never behind text, never an area larger than a fingertip. One hue (27.0° / 26.9°): the dark value is the light one lifted for its ground, not a second colour — do not re-pick either. 3.15 / 3.46 light and 7.40 / 6.13 dark on canvas / card
accent.spec: A28 (a), (b); design/focus-card-system.md §2, §3; Part III laws ③ ④ (narrowed) ⑤

onInk.role: The label on an ink fill (the primary capsule): cream on navy in light, navy on cream in dark — 14.61 / 15.05

destructive.role: Red — only inside a destructive confirm sheet, in both modes, and nowhere else. 5.88 / 6.09 on its sheet

sheetScrim.role: The scrim behind a sheet — rgba(20,39,68,0.34) light, rgba(4,9,17,0.58) dark

macroColors.spec: A16's bounded exception to Part III law ⑥ (nutrition surfaces only) — NOT on A28's table and NOT re-picked by it: the design system is silent on nutrition, so these stand unchanged until the Nutrition session rules on them (docs/debt.md 2026-09-19, A28). Dark carbs measures 2.79:1 on A28's dark card; dark is unreachable until the light lock lifts.

macroProtein.role: Macro identity — protein (pine). Nutrition surfaces ONLY; identity, never status: it never changes with over / under / on target; never beside an ember element (law ⑥'s bounded exception). Solid fill. 8.86:1 on bone.
macroProtein.spec: Part III law ⑥ as amended by A16 (ux-plan 7.4); nutrition addendum §4

macroCarbs.role: Macro identity — carbs (slate). Nutrition surfaces ONLY; identity, never status. Solid fill + ink hairline. 3.32:1 on bone (a graphical object, never text).
macroCarbs.spec: Part III law ⑥ as amended by A16 (ux-plan 7.4); nutrition addendum §4

macroFat.role: Macro identity — fat (mulberry). Nutrition surfaces ONLY; identity, never status. Outline + hairline. 8.84:1 on bone.
macroFat.spec: Part III law ⑥ as amended by A16 (ux-plan 7.4); nutrition addendum §4

colorAliases.spec: A28 (2026-09-19): the names screens still call colours by, each pointing at ONE row of the table above, so the whole app recolors with no screen edit. An alias carries no value of its own. Each goes when the last screen that reads it is redesigned onto the table's own names (docs/debt.md 2026-09-19, A28). Retired outright with A28 because nothing read them: secondaryButtonOutline (the pre-A18.11 hairline outline — an alias with that name would re-arm the trap A18.11 closed) and success (no green for done; a navy success invites misuse).

hairline.why: card edges and dividers — a boundary between two surfaces; 17 of its 21 uses sit on the canvas, where the table's seam is hairlineOnCanvas (1.21:1; 1.33:1 on a card, still a seam and never a control)

controlOutline.why: the boundary of a legacy OUTLINE control — A18.11's 3:1 gate holds (3.32 / 3.64 light, 3.98 / 3.29 dark) until the redesign replaces outline controls with the system's text buttons; controlBorder (~1.6:1) would fail it

missedGray.why: the unlit flame and missed marks — a miss is a fact, not a verdict; never red

ember.why: the reward shapes — A28 (b) leaves only the flame glyph and the ring's arc; heat-map fills, day marks and crew dots still drawn with it turn ink in their screen's redesign

emberText.why: orange WORDS retire under A28 (b) (accent measures 3.15:1 on the canvas, below 4.5:1 for small text); the celebration's XP numeral and unit move to accent in the Logger session

emberTint.why: tints and ring tracks — A28 (b): no accent wash; the ring track is a neutral

danger.why: red — A28 (a) confines it to destructive confirms; the error lines and delete labels still drawn with it move in their screen's redesign

typography.spec: A28 (a), (f) — the type scale of design/focus-card-system.md §4. SF Pro throughout (Display above 28 pt, Text below — the system font picks it by size). EVERY NUMERAL is SF Pro Rounded (rounded: true) — set counts, weights, reps, streak, ring, XP, targets, week and workout counts; words are never rounded. Size in points on iOS and px on web. Tracking is a FRACTION of the size (−0.05 = −5%): SwiftUI's .tracking takes points, so a view passes size × tracking; CSS writes it in em. An uppercase role renders its string uppercase and the string itself stays sentence case (VoiceOver reads the string). Scale with Dynamic Type: relativeTo names the text style whose curve a role's size follows (UIFontMetrics — the builder's pairing, R-084), so a 96 pt numeral grows like a large title and an 11 pt eyebrow like caption 2.

screenTitleBare.role: screen title on a bare screen (no reward block — no-plan Home's card hero)

heroUnit.role: unit label beside a hero numeral

body.role: body (the system's Medium half of "Medium / Semibold")

bodySemibold.role: body (the system's Semibold half of "Medium / Semibold")

eyebrowUnderRing.role: eyebrow under the ring and the streak, +12%

primaryLabel.role: the primary capsule's label (system §8, Primary button)

textButton.role: a text button's label (system §8, Text button)

tabLabel.role: tab label — the smallest type in the app (nothing below 10 pt)

spacing.spec: Decision Registry G5 (2026-09-04) — 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32, nothing off-scale (points on iOS, px on web). A14 (2026-09-09) adds two ROLE aliases onto that same scale so macro and micro rhythm can diverge without a new number: sectionGap (24) is the gap BETWEEN groups, rowGap (8) the gap WITHIN one — a uniform 16 pt everywhere is why Home read as empty rather than composed.

sizes.spec: GAP (agent, 2026-09-04): component sizes the spec never states, named once so no layout number is typed inline (C7 spirit); points on iOS, px on web

focus.spec: A28 (d), (f) — the Focus Card system's rhythm and component sizes (design/focus-card-system.md §5, §8), for REDESIGNED screens only (R-083 (5)); a screen not yet redesigned keeps the G5 scale and the sizes above. Each value enters in the session that first draws it (C7). flameGlyph and rewardGap are measured on mockup 03, which draws them without numbering them (R-084).

elevation.spec: A28 (a) — design/focus-card-system.md §6: LIGHT lifts a card with a two-layer shadow in the ink colour (0 1 3 at 5%, 0 14 34 at 8%); DARK uses tone alone and no shadow — the view gates the shadow on colorScheme.

opacity.spec: GAP (agent, 2026-09-04): the one opacity used for a disabled control; named so no literal is typed inline

motion.spec: 6.4 — one spring curve app-wide, defined once; values = Decision Registry G5 (2026-09-04)
